claims: Artemis II launched from Launch Complex 39B at the Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
Artemis II lifted off on April 1, 2026, at 6:35 p.m. EDT.
Artemis II was powered by the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
Artemis II was a 10-day journey around the Moon.
Kennedy Space Center is located in Merritt Island, Florida.
The Artemis II launch was visible across Florida's Space Coast, including Titusville and the surrounding area.
